claim: The tweezers are meant to be used with an Aresis-supplied filter cube in the microscope's epi-fluorescence turret. That turret's mechanically actuated shutter blocks the laser from the objective and the eyepieces, and the cube's dichroic and blocking filters attenuate infrared that could reach the eyepiece path to well below the Class 1 limit.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 Laser Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed in C:/Program Files/Aresis/Tweez300/Manuals/ (sha256 264ab54b...): printed page 8 (PDF page 10). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. Which turret and position hold the Aresis cube on this bench is not recorded in this store. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
